assertions.name: borromean_chi_21_reproduces_t17
assertions.source: Independent R-matrix derivation of χ^(2,1)(β_Bor) must reproduce T17 (PR #1933): 2 − 3h⁴ − h⁶ exactly.

assertions.name: twelve_cells_emitted
assertions.source: Phase 1 + Phase 2 emit 3·H_3 + 3·H_3 + 3·H_2 = 12 cells (Borromean + Figure-eight + Hopf + Trefoil + Cinquefoil).

description: Phase 1 + 2 of the 3-axis (knot, partition, atom) derived-χ catalogue. Emits 12 cells across 5 census knots (Borromean, Figure-eight, Hopf, Trefoil, Cinquefoil). H_3 knots via R-matrix on V⊗³ + Schur-Weyl; B_2 knots via 1-dim Hecke reps. Borromean (2,1) cross-validates T17 (PR #1933) exactly.
